The generated vegetation outputs in `Assets/_Game/Art/Generated/Vegetation/` use
the pinned seed and LOD presets recorded in `ez-tree-presets.json`. The Unity
player does not include npm, Three.js, the EZ-Tree editor, or the source download.
Only generated files named by the preset are eligible for the asset allowlist.
